name: Santosh Primary School
tagline: Holistic foundational learning and creative expression
description: Santosh Primary School Bangalore pairs academic rigor with personal attention. We focus on developing core computational skills, reading comprehension, and social harmony among young learners.

features.title: Balanced Core Curriculum
features.detail: Equal emphasis on language fluency, mathematics, environmental studies, and computer basics from early grades.

features.title: Active Classroom Participation
features.detail: Interactive teaching methods ensure students speak, ask questions, and engage rather than passively copying notes.

features.title: Regular Teacher-Parent Alignment
features.detail: Monthly academic and personal reviews ensure each child receives customized encouragement at school and at home.
